clean_body: A Border Disarmed by Directive, An Accountability Crisis by Design | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more A Border Disarmed by Directive, An Accountability Crisis by Design | | | May 22 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- THE CORE CHARGE A border is more than a line on a map. It is the perimeter of the national home--the first measure of whether a government fulfills its most basic constitutional duty: to provide for the common defence. That perimeter has been deliberately disarmed. Not by invasion. By directive. The Department of Homeland Security, under the Biden Administration, through agency discretion rather than congressional vote, terminated enforcement protocols, created mass parole programs, and deprioritized border security. The result: 5,622 Floridians dead from fentanyl in a single year. Poison that flowed through a gate opened by bureaucrats who never faced a voter, never answered to a constituency, never accounted for a consequence. This is not a border crisis. It is an accountability crisis. And it is constitutional in the truest sense--a collapse of the constitutional design itself. The Founders built a system where those who govern must face those they govern. James Madison insisted that government must control itself through representation. When a bureaucrat can open the gates of our national home without your representative's vote, that control mechanism is broken. When the Trump Administration subsequently reversed these directives and restored enforcement, the results were measurable--just as Florida's S.A.F.E. program proved at the state level. The method of governance determines the outcome. The Biden method produced graves. The enforcement method produces security. Faced with this engineered crisis, the political establishment offers only "managerial surrender"--diagnosing the problem while offering transparency bills and enforcement tweaks that manage the symptoms, never addressing the root. This document is not a white paper. It is an indictment. It enters into evidence the specific directives, their human cost, the theft of political accountability, and the single legislative remedy that can dismantle this structure: the REINS Act. The charge is dereliction. The verdict is yours. I. THE BLUEPRINT -- HOW DIRECTIVE DISARMED THE BORDER This is not a dry policy debate about immigration. It is a live war over who controls the constitutional chain of consent--and whether those who rewrite that chain must ever face the people it binds. The Florida Model: How Real Security Works Before detailing the federal failure, understand the proven alternative. Under Governor DeSantis, Florida refused to accept the federal government's managerial surrender. The S.A.F.E. program demonstrated what happens when a state acts decisively: 46% reduction in fentanyl deaths since implementation 600 pounds of fentanyl seized--poison that will never reach a child Nearly 3,000 traffickers arrested--criminals who will never sell again 970 firearms confiscated from convicted felons and drug cartels Direct state action through accountable government produced better security outcomes than any federal directive ever could. This is effective enforcement: transparent, local, and decisive. The Federal Directive War: A Case Study in Failure In 2022, the Department of Homeland Security under the Biden Administration issued a series of directives that unilaterally dismantled border enforcement--not through congressional vote, but through bureaucratic fiat. The Civil Immigration Enforcement Priorities memorandum deprioritized enforcement against non-criminal aliens, effectively signaling open borders. Border encounters surged to record levels. The termination of the Migrant Protection Protocols ended "Remain in Mexico" through unilateral directive, releasing migrants into the interior while awaiting asylum proceedings. Over 1.7 million got-aways were reported since FY2021--1.7 million individuals who entered this country untracked, unvetted, and unaccounted for. The CHNV Parole Programs created mass parole programs for Cubans, Haitians, Nicaraguans, and Venezuelans through executive memo rather than congressional authorization, admitting up to 30,000 migrants per month. The constitutional separation of powers was violated; border enforcement was effectively privatized by executive fiat. This is the architecture of unaccountability in action. It is designed for control, not security; for discretion, not defence. The Fentanyl Flow U.S. Customs and Border Protection seized over 27,000 pounds of fentanyl at the southern border in FY2023--a 330% increase from FY2020. Seizures indicate flow. The increase represents a massive escalation in the volume of poison reaching American communities. Every death was preventable. Florida's S.A.F.E. program proved it. II. THE HUMAN COST -- EVIDENCE FROM FLORIDA The architecture of unaccountability is not an abstract policy failure. It is a lived experience of shattered families, poisoned communities, and--the most insidious theft of all--the loss of political accountability from the people the system claims to protect. The Specific Victims Mari Rodriguez lost her 18-year-old daughter Iman to fentanyl poisoning in South Florida. One pill. One night. A family shattered by a poison that should never have reached our streets. In Congressional District 11, deputies arrested a convicted felon armed with a handgun and an AR-15, caught with trafficking amounts of fentanyl at the Rodeway Inn in Bushnell. The threat is not at the border. The threat is already inside our communities. The Deeper Wound: The Loss of Political Accountability The human cost extends beyond lives. It is the loss of your voice and your power. You cannot petition a DHS directive. You cannot vote out an agency appointee. When bureaucrats can rewrite immigration law without your representative's vote, the constitutional design has been inverted. Those who govern no longer face those they govern. The control mechanism Madison insisted upon--accountability through representation--has been shed. The graves demand accountability. III. THE DOCTRINE OF MANAGERIAL SURRENDER The establishment's record reveals a consistent philosophy: when confronted with systemic failure, address the paperwork, not the power structure. This is Managerial Surrender--diagnosing the crisis while offering only bureaucratic adjustments that treat the symptoms and ignore the disease. When Floridians die from fentanyl at record rates, the establishment's response is not to dismantle the administrative state's unilateral authority to disarm the border through agency discretion. It is to hold hearings. To issue reports. To propose "transparency" bills that illuminate the crisis while refusing to dismantle the method that produces it. The structural tools that would end the method of failure--the REINS Act, the Administrative Independence Act, the Bill of Rights Restoration--have not been advanced, championed, or passed. These are the legislative mechanisms that would force bureaucrats to face the people's representatives, restore the constitutional separation of powers, and return unauthorized federal functions to the states. The establishment refuses to advance them. Instead, it offers hearings, dashboards, and "transparency" bills--the bureaucratic equivalent of monitoring the house fire while refusing to turn on the hose. The dereliction is this: The establishment identifies the symptom--border insecurity, fentanyl deaths, bureaucratic overreach--but its prescribed remedy is always a managerial adjustment to live with the disease, never a legislative mechanism to cure it. It has surrendered the constitutional duty of a legislator--to make and unmake law--in favor of managing the bureaucracy that has replaced it. This is the politics of sustained outrage: stoking resentment, promising to scalp scapegoats, profiting from the problem--while never offering a structural solution that would resolve it. Outrage politics has no endpoint. It needs the crisis to continue. Constructive outrage has an endpoint: when the REINS Act passes, the structural failure ends. When the administrative state is brought to heel, the outrage resolves. The Kitchen Table does not need a performance. It needs a champion who strikes the root. IV. THE LEGISLATIVE STRIKE -- THE REINS ACT This section presents the solution not as another managerial adjustment, but as a structural mechanism to restore constitutional accountability. Mechanism: The REINS Act (Regulations from the Executive in Need of Scrutiny Act) requires that any "major rule" with an economic impact of $100 million or more from a federal agency like DHS must be approved by a joint resolution of Congress before taking effect. Impact: It restores the constitutional chain of consent. No longer can an agency directive that rewrites immigration law take effect without a direct, on-the-record vote by the people's representatives. It would have forced a vote on the enforcement priorities memo, the termination of the Migrant Protection Protocols, and the CHNV parole programs. Contrast: Unlike enforcement bills or transparency legislation, the REINS Act does not manage the crisis created by directive; it dismantles the bureaucratic power to create that crisis. It shifts the fight from managing death tolls to preventing them. The REINS Act forces bureaucrats to face the people 's representatives. CONCLUSION: A CHOICE OF FUTURES The evidence is incontrovertible. An unaccountable federal bureaucracy has constructed a system that makes the most basic constitutional duty--providing for the common defence--impossible to fulfill through representative government. The 5,622 Floridians dead from fentanyl prove the collapse is underway. The establishment responds with Managerial Surrender: hearings and transparency bills that acknowledge the crisis while refusing to dismantle the administrative state's unilateral authority to disarm the border through agency discretion. This is more than a failed policy record. It is a dereliction of the fundamental duty of representation: to wield public power to secure public good. Therefore, the voters of Florida's 11th District face a binary choice between two futures: PATH A: MANAGERIAL SURRENDER. Accept the continued delegation of your power to distant agencies. Resign yourself to a future of hearings, dashboards, managed death tolls, and outrage politics that sustains the problem rather than solving it. Watch as your voice in your security is replaced by a federal directive number. PATH B: CONSTRUCTIVE OUTRAGE. Reclaim the legislative power ceded to the administrative state. Pass the REINS Act to force Congress to be accountable for the directives that govern your security. Dismantle the architecture of unaccountability and restore the conditions for enforcement, accountability, and genuine, citizen-driven protection of our communities. When the REINS Act passes, the structural failure ends. When the administrative state is brought to heel, the outrage resolves. Table secured. This campaign chooses Path B. The REINS Act is more than a bill; it is the mechanism to restore consent. It does not ask you to trust a better manager. It demands that your representative become a true legislator again. It is my responsibility to expose this corruption of our constitutional order. It is your power to demand justice at the ballot box. Vote. Fuel. Fight. -- The Reckoning is close. Choose Constructive Outrage over Outrage Politics. Vote Ivette Palomo and The American Kitchen Table on August 18, 2026. Fight to win! Strike the root. Secure the table. Friend,
This campaign has always been about building something bigger than just one election.
We are building a grassroots movement rooted in community, integrity, and generational change.
That’s why the arrows in our logo matter so much to me—they represent a new generation stepping up to build what comes next, from universal healthcare to the next generation of good jobs in Southeast Michigan.
Today, I wanted to share something really special with you.
A Saint Clair Shores artist, Deanna Clyne at Eastside Clay, handcrafted 26 beautiful pottery ring dishes for our campaign, each featuring our campaign logo. They’re about 3 to 4 inches, each one is unique and made by hand. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/east.side.clay?refcode=x_260522_pottery_act]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/east.side.clay?refcode=x_260522_pottery_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/east.side.clay?refcode=x_260522_pottery_act] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/east.side.clay?refcode=x_260522_pottery_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/east.side.clay?refcode=x_260522_pottery_act]
RESERVE ONE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/east.side.clay?refcode=x_260522_pottery_act]
As many of you know, this campaign will be historic. I will be the first woman elected to represent most of Michigan’s 10th District - the women and girls of Warren, Sterling Heights, Eastpointe, Clinton Township, and more have never had a woman represent them in the US House. These pieces are designed as a reminder that real change is built by ordinary people who choose to believe things can move forward.
We are offering them for a contribution of $100 to help support our grassroots campaign and an amazing local artist. For supporters outside the district, we can also carefully package and ship them to you. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/east.side.clay?refcode=x_260522_pottery_act]
Whether you place yours on a nightstand, kitchen counter, or desk, I hope it serves as a reminder that ordinary people still have the power to build something extraordinary together.
If you’d like to reserve one of the 26 handmade pieces, you can contribute here: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/east.side.clay?refcode=x_260522_pottery_act]
RESERVE ONE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/east.side.clay?refcode=x_260522_pottery_act]
Thank you for believing in this campaign and for helping us build what comes next.
— Christina
Mom on a Mission, Former Prosecutor & Candidate for Congress (MI-10)

Now she’s running to bring that same dedication to Congress, working to put the middle class first, protect the American Dream, and ensure every community can thrive. She fights for safe neighborhoods, fair opportunities, and a future where everyone can succeed.

name: Chris Pappas
subject: This is what’s at stake:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
If we’re going to compete everywhere in this state, we need the resources to match the urgency people are feeling on the ground.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=6773%2E582294%2EUqpL0b)
Team, it's Chris.
**There’s nothing quite like a New Hampshire Democratic convention.**
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260522_1.7-OCw3&refcode=em20260522-1&t=2&akid=6773%2E582294%2EUqpL0b)
Last weekend in Dover, you could feel it the moment you walked in: organizers reconnecting after long cycles, new volunteers stepping up for the first time, and activists and local leaders all focused on the same thing — what it’s going to take to win in 2026.
**People here know exactly what’s at stake.**
Families are being squeezed by the cost of housing, health care, and groceries. Small businesses are trying to keep up with rising costs. Seniors are worried about the benefits they’ve earned.
That frustration is real – and it’s pushing Granite Staters to get more involved.
What stood out to me most this weekend is how much people are leaning in. They’re organizing. They’re talking to their neighbors. They’re signing up to help. They know this is going to be a tough race, and they’re acting like it.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260522_1.7-OCw3&refcode=em20260522-1&t=3&akid=6773%2E582294%2EUqpL0b)
**[Donate »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260522_1.7-OCw3&refcode=em20260522-1&t=4&akid=6773%2E582294%2EUqpL0b)**
But here’s the truth: That kind of energy doesn’t sustain itself. **If we’re going to compete everywhere in this state, we need the resources to match the urgency people are feeling on the ground.**
**[So I’m asking you directly: Will you pitch in $5 today to help fuel our work from now until Election Day?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260522_1.7-OCw3&refcode=em20260522-1&t=5&akid=6773%2E582294%2EUqpL0b)**
Every contribution helps us reach more voters, organize in more communities, and make sure we’re ready for the fight ahead in 2026.
New Hampshire has never been a place that backs down from a tough race. We won’t start now.
**[If you’re ready to show Republicans that New Hampshire’s Senate seat is not for sale, step up and chip in $5 to our campaign now. We need all hands on deck in order to keep this seat blue and flip the Senate.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260522_1.7-OCw3&refcode=em20260522-1&t=6&akid=6773%2E582294%2EUqpL0b)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260522_1.7-OCw3&amount=5&refcode=em20260522-1&t=25&akid=6773%2E582294%2EUqpL0b)**
The energy is real. The momentum is building. And I’m ready to keep showing up and doing the work alongside you.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260522_1.7-OCw3&refcode=em20260522-1&t=26&akid=6773%2E582294%2EUqpL0b)
Thanks for being part of this.
– Chris
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

clean_body: If we’re going to compete everywhere in this state, we need the resources to match the urgency people are feeling on the ground. Team, it's Chris. There’s nothing quite like a New Hampshire Democratic convention. Last weekend in Dover, you could feel it the moment you walked in: organizers reconnecting after long cycles, new volunteers stepping up for the first time, and activists and local leaders all focused on the same thing — what it’s going to take to win in 2026. People here know exactly what’s at stake. Families are being squeezed by the cost of housing, health care, and groceries. Small businesses are trying to keep up with rising costs. Seniors are worried about the benefits they’ve earned. That frustration is real – and it’s pushing Granite Staters to get more involved. What stood out to me most this weekend is how much people are leaning in. They’re organizing. They’re talking to their neighbors. They’re signing up to help. They know this is going to be a tough race, and they’re acting like it. But here’s the truth: That kind of energy doesn’t sustain itself. If we’re going to compete everywhere in this state, we need the resources to match the urgency people are feeling on the ground. Every contribution helps us reach more voters, organize in more communities, and make sure we’re ready for the fight ahead in 2026. New Hampshire has never been a place that backs down from a tough race. We won’t start now. The energy is real. The momentum is building. And I’m ready to keep showing up and doing the work alongside you. Thanks for being part of this. – Chris New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

## **Working Families Party Leader Jane Kim Endorses Esther Kim-Varet for Congress in CA-40**
**ORANGE, CA** — Jane Kim, longtime Working Families Party leader and the frontrunning Democrat California Insurance Commissioner, has endorsed Esther Kim-Varet for Congress in California’s 40th District. “Esther Kim-Varet represents a new generation of leadership — grounded in lived experience, committed to economic justice, and ready to fight for the future young people deserve,” said Jane Kim. Kim’s endorsement adds to growing momentum behind Kim-Varet’s campaign, which has continued to gain support from grassroots organizations, working families, women leaders, and young voters across Orange County and Riverside County. A working mother, entrepreneur, and daughter of immigrants, Esther Kim-Varet has built a people-powered campaign focused on lowering costs for working families, protecting reproductive freedom, defending democracy, and expanding economic opportunity. “In a district like CA-40, voters are looking for leadership that is present, accountable, and understands the real struggles families are facing,” said Kim-Varet. “I’m honored to have Jane Kim’s support as we continue building a coalition focused on affordability, opportunity, and real representation.” As one of the most competitive races in California, CA-40 remains critical for Democrats heading into the June primary. Kim-Varet’s campaign continues to build momentum as voters seek new leadership focused on results for working families and the next generation.
* * *

| RNC, NCGOP Deliver Major Election Integrity Win, Forcing Removal of Non-Citizens from Voter Rolls Under Jury Duty Law
---
> WASHINGTON, D.C. - This week, the Republican National Committee (RNC) and the North Carolina Republican Party secured a major election integrity victory by entering into a consent judgment with the North Carolina State Board of Elections (NCSBE) in their lawsuit over the Board's failure to remove non-citizens from voter rolls leading up to the 2024 election.
> The agreement requires the NCSBE to comply with state law by using jury-duty records to identify and remove individuals who have acknowledged they are not U.S. citizens from North Carolina's voter rolls. Once approved by the court, the consent judgment will carry the full force of a court order.
> Under this law, anyone who claims they are not a U.S. citizen to avoid jury duty must have their information sent to state election officials to verify they are ineligible to vote and initiate their removal from voter rolls. The RNC, North Carolina Republican Party, and the NCSBE have agreed to the terms of the proposed consent judgment.
> "This agreement is a major win for election integrity in North Carolina," said RNC Chairman Joe Gruters. "It's straightforward: if someone admits they're not a U.S. citizen during jury duty, that information should be used to check the voter rolls and remove anyone who doesn't belong. Our fight ensures the law is actually enforced and North Carolina Democrats can't cheat by padding voter rolls with people who are not citizens."
> Background:
* This week, a North Carolina court approved a [consent judgment](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001u4vlbEp8JUcm-YO4Tp3nn5gQ9orGM-AW_El5E6BoJ2p2bB_cADuvuojDBrl4GGuBhE9vJREugLZSSRmJivesDLERonQ3cJSUDmQeoYcOSkTQVy5RJkanTBkvpmanVdHezykbnsYFl88Dg7fdxeEDLeD4vJhhFkW6GqLXLifDD1QtIm2WULiOhU1n4Gpk-4xeAUvRtKtoqRwsStHVPOuqfwX-70W6xAHiejgZjjnzbA5GY6Dahxt2tgelAdvO_6-Ci6VMtTdC7AEiwQqr5hmCoUrf3vZL50kHhI5XnkuFTXEyKw3NMCFK7Vggyuw6C0Bunxbsj8Hqg_EpoBdg5cdE4iNHxSEGOpJlucc5Mo_GX2Dbrdab3pziWOWG0d66iwrL-8McNMhr5mq97jgg1mOlf0qqOQ0yyVjRl9v7MHCh_isV4R8aBhyH57FmJVXdqIQJc2_n4pvNRdEu6ort2zJcitM_KRqMLI_P-SrDZp86yGlLP4BI-yChSN3tW66T91Jvqe-o5VeM_VYV-389YoA-1urTZHozvG_m7i93DcW9kbQAQ6lK6G51BALxeDo0GPcQcQbVkkmD0k_UtUIi8BkGA-Panr3itMKej5oek_KKrqIqzR_mFR4C42z6KFXr5eK_DaQpUXqxxfFfdESkJd8cKaKag--Onf6LM2fhvc9_AZVTIlT8ilHpQ8seK5djfuLEv_MOwXa8zy3qBYlnOQzh5FrJSYMokX2d9LNh3qmkanCmJ3quG67kwg_5mjwikRvb7cxDLIWz2ZmHo8xAIjZ2ZXhQLYNbbZzK_N3rTzhje0kwtGwuyrxeVEcnzaF5xoHv859GOrRgyOxUld1xiVNBlNff1-KihaZBXDG68Qblh8NNw7KnPtGbGokdtnYDaVLL6ULTzurjlmaiYhdFCtnXF8f31lCHTMmM113zsMvr4wWOVkqyrrgn0YuSA1mO-lj66HY3vS4Q0H5FapIiY-NwV6OZR6JG-gHjvfsrBWI2gM3TUDDw_4fT8iH4J84a_bQLmvJFW6ymKZz67SdPHecsuicVYXJB3qaK&c=sfCR55yWgtzQZBYEsRXbi-7QeCjmfY0IO8Io4gVVb6l6ssk6Eku4-w==&ch=tr06Z9syGhRAEhFEKwFdeJneNB5iiouJgEEMh4jrBnJJ3PgIgb0b5Q==) between the RNC and North Carolina Republican Party and the North Carolina State Board of Elections (NCSBE) that requires the Board to use jury-duty records to help identify and remove non-citizens from voter rolls.

The NCSBE can then use this information to determine whether that person appears on the voter rolls, or worse, has voted in past elections. In 2024, the RNC filed a public-records request with the NCSBE to ensure the Board was in compliance with the law, however, the Board failed to provide any response. After the RNC and North Carolina Republican Party sued, the Board agreed to follow state law and utilize the information received from county clerks to remove non-citizens from the voter rolls. This common-sense law makes U.S. elections fair and secure. The RNC is engaged in litigation across the country to ensure that non-citizens are removed from voter rolls and that only lawful votes are counted. The RNC is actively defending President Trump's == requiring documentary proof of citizenship, and the RNC filed a == at the Supreme Court to defend Arizona's law similarly requiring documentary proof of citizenship. body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2283%2E5691347%2EadXMj7)

Peter,
As I travel across Georgia, more and more people of every background and belief tell me their stories and share their frustration about the chaos and corruption of the Trump administration.
_I spoke to a cotton grower here in Georgia about the skyrocketing prices of fertilizer and diesel caused by the war._
_I spoke to a woman in her early 60s who waits tables for a living. She’s fighting cancer. She told me she was going to lose her health coverage in the middle of chemotherapy because Trump refused to extend ACA tax credits._
***
And it’s not just Democrats and independents sharing these stories. *Republicans* take me aside, or they call me on the phone.
They tell me they’re afraid of where this President has taken us, and they don’t want it to go on.
They tell me they’re voting for a Democrat for the first time!
And it’s no mystery why: this is the cruelest and most arrogant group of people who have ever ascended to high office, and their cruelty and their arrogance are matched only by their incompetence.
***
**But it doesn’t have to be this way.**
Everywhere I go, across our state, people also tell me they are desperate for change and for new ideas.
_The student working through college who still needs food stamps to make rent, whose conscience can’t stand their tax dollars being used to lock up immigrant children here at home._
_The South Georgia farmer whose costs rise and earnings fall each year, whose kids have left the family farm, who’s still waiting for federal aid long after the storm._
_The young couple expecting their first child — who worry how they’ll afford a crib and a stroller, let alone a first home — whose health insurance just went up a thousand dollars per month._
***
I believe we can reform our corrupt politics. I believe we will escape this moral tailspin and recommit ourselves to the values that have made this country great.
But none of this is possible without victory this November, and the battle is already on. Georgia is the most crucial battleground state in the country, and this will be the tightest and hardest-fought U.S. Senate race this year.

The 2024 DNC autopsy report was released, but this is not really about what is inside the report.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..szYS3qTtfi5xb1wT7pWkOLZ10LMBIgtUVaC4sAODtlk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=198838933)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..szYS3qTtfi5xb1wT7pWkOLZ10LMBIgtUVaC4sAODtlk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=198838933)
Plenty of people are talking about that. They are going to pick apart the findings, the mistakes, the omissions, the spelling errors, the factual problems, the issues it did not address, and whether it actually tells Democrats anything useful about what went wrong in 2024.
But that is **NOT** the real issue here.
The real issue is **leadership**.
And the sooner Democrats understand that this is a leadership issue, not a report-content issue, the faster we can move into the midterms with some actual clarity about what the hell is going wrong inside this party.
* * *
### Ken Martin Created This Problem
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e57c5770-9c8a-4c4b-be42-73ccf45c8566?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DNC Chair Ken Martin](https://substack.com/redirect/1f7868d0-fbeb-4809-bb2f-983ba2165e77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Ken Martin](https://substack.com/redirect/1f7868d0-fbeb-4809-bb2f-983ba2165e77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) campaigned to become DNC chair by talking about transparency. He talked about 2016. He talked about how the DNC needed to release the 2016 autopsy report so the party could understand its mistakes, learn from them, and be honest with the people inside the party.
Then he won.
After winning, he commissioned the 2024 autopsy report with the full expectation, at least from a lot of people, that it would be released. That expectation was not created out of nowhere. It came from the way he talked about transparency. It came from the way he framed the need for an autopsy.
But then the report became a problem.
By now, it is well known that he enlisted someone close to him to do the report, and the final product was apparently not up to par. It had spelling errors. It had factual problems. It failed to touch on major issues Democrats were actually talking about. It did not seriously engage with some of the concerns younger voters and other constituencies were raising.
_(If you want to read about the autopsy report, click the below from[Laura Rodriguez-Carbone](https://open.substack.com/users/504723763-laura-rodriguez-carbone?utm_source=mentions))_
The Whisper Campaign
[The Report the DNC Didn't Want you to Read](https://substack.com/redirect/02824af7-6864-4128-a404-32f3882ca397?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I have spent this series arguing one thing about endorsements. The danger is not the act of endorsing itself. The danger is the race to define the choice early, before voters engage, so a small group settles the outcome and calls the result inevitable. I called it a cartel. The word underneath is corruption, and it runs through everything the report des...
[Read more](https://substack.com/redirect/02824af7-6864-4128-a404-32f3882ca397?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
17 hours ago * 6 likes * 1 comment * Laura Rodriguez-Carbone
[Share The Angry Democrat](https://substack..wYu5OA-2_J4WkIvQxXF1LGs-tkH28sj5llVCm1uF1eg?)
So instead of saying, "This report was sloppy, I take responsibility, and I am going to commission a better one," Martin decided not to release it.
Then came the explanations.
It was "death by a thousand cuts." It was not one issue. The party would use the report internally. The DNC was going to learn from it and get better for 2026.
And honestly, I understood that argument.
I even said in a video (below) that while he never should have created the expectation that the report would be released, there was a reasonable argument for holding it close **if the report was going to create more infighting than clarity.** If the report was incomplete, sloppy, or not useful, then maybe releasing it would just make the party look even more dysfunctional.
So I was not against keeping it internal.
But then he released it anyway.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f3feca80-2ba4-4921-9691-239a8afcd162?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
### The Problem
Some people are praising Martin for transparency now that the report has been released.
I am not.
Because the problem is not simply whether the report was released. The problem is the decision-making that got us here.
**First** , this showed nepotism inside the party. He hired someone close to him to do an important job, and that job apparently was not done well. That alone is a problem. If the report was haphazard, sloppy, incomplete, or factually weak, then Martin should have owned that. He should have said the work was not good enough, taken responsibility, and commissioned a serious replacement.
He did not do that.
**Second** , he ran on transparency and then failed to follow through when transparency became inconvenient. That is not ideal, but it is also not uncommon in politics. People say one thing when they want power, then do something else once they have it.
**Third** , he kept changing the explanation. He told people why he was not releasing it. He framed it as an internal tool. He tried to manage the backlash. Then he reversed himself and released it anyway.
**Fourth** , and this is the part that really gets me, the DNC then tried to distance itself from the report with disclaimers saying the party does not stand behind it.
Well, if you do not stand behind it, why the fuck did you release it?
That is not transparency. That is fear. That is a leadership team trying to do everything at once and somehow making every option worse.
If the report was good, release it and stand behind it.
If the report was bad, own the mistake and replace it.
If the report was incomplete, say that.
But do not hide it, defend hiding it, release it later, and then tell everyone not to take it too seriously.
That is exactly the kind of weak, incoherent leadership people are tired of.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f1899eaa-73b5-419f-96e8-6bb11991f6b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Pod Save America](https://substack.com/redirect/76bd0c17-6755-4862-9885-10c2a0edd2c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
### The Party Has a Leadership Problem
There are three major issues here.
**First** is lack of leadership. The party is being damaged by people who do not have bold ideas, clear direction, or the ability to unify through policy and action. Instead, too often, they try to unify through fear, pressure, and force. They tell people the stakes are too high to ask questions. They tell people criticism is dangerous. They tell people to fall in line because the alternative is worse.
That might work for one election cycle. It does not build a durable party.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/01a2ec24-2d90-4a13-961e-8c2795c188c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The **second** issue is moral clarity. This situation would not have played out this way if the Democratic Party actually had moral clarity about what it stands for, what it wants to run on, and how it plans to lead. A party with an ideological foundation can take criticism. It can commission a report. It can read the findings. It can admit mistakes. It can explain what comes next.
A party without that foundation flails.
It panders. It gaslights. It hides. It leaks. It spins. It releases a report and then distances itself from the report it released.
That is not strength. That is weakness.
The **third** issue is the disconnect from the people. Voters care about issues. They care about whether the party understands their lives. They care about cost of living, corruption, housing, jobs, health care, war, democracy, corporate power, and whether anyone in leadership is actually listening.
But right now, too much of the Democratic Party is stuck in a branding war.
You see Democrats reaching for tough-guy personas to show white male voters that they are just like them. Tim Walz pulls an air filter out of his car to show he understands engines. Graham Platner is the oyster farmer. Others try to present themselves as rugged, working-class, no-nonsense guys.
But if the party thinks it can win with image instead of policy, people are going to see through that shit.
People do not want cosplay. They want a party that knows what it believes and can actually fight for it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/edd672ee-e0b5-485c-a30a-bdd14d9ba81d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
### The Autopsy Is a Symptom
The Angry Democrat is reader-supported.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..szYS3qTtfi5xb1wT7pWkOLZ10LMBIgtUVaC4sAODtlk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=198838933)
Confidence in the Democratic Party is in the garbage. Approval ratings are in the toilet. People are frustrated, disillusioned, and tired that the only plan is "Trump bad, Republicans bad, GOP bad."
Again, all of those criticisms may be true. But that is not a governing vision.
That is not an ideological foundation.
The problem is not the autopsy report. The problem is all the decisions that led to this moment. The nepotism. The gaslighting. The sloppy work. The bad judgment. The media tour explaining why the report would not be released. The reversal. The disclaimers. The backtracking. The fact that the party somehow managed to make itself look worse at every stage.
This is not about the contents of the report.
This is about leadership.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/cc4e025e-f770-407b-a35a-bb80042f02dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It is about a Democratic Party that too often tries to create loyalty through fear instead of trust. It is about a party that tries to force unity instead of earning it. It is about a party that talks about being a big tent while punishing internal disagreement, ignoring grassroots frustration, and failing to build around clear Democratic populist ideas.
That is the hill I will die on.
We can do better.
We should do better.
And people are absolutely sick of being told that asking for better means they are hurting the party.
* * *
### The Solution
The Democratic Party needs leadership that can be honest without panicking.
If the party commissions a report and the report is bad, say it is bad. If the process was flawed, admit the process was flawed. If someone made a bad hiring decision, own it. If the party needs to start over, start over. That is leadership.
The party also needs moral clarity. Democrats need to stop trying to brand their way out of an identity crisis and start building around actual policy, actual accountability, and actual economic and democratic reform. The party needs to stand for something people can understand without needing a consultant to explain it.
And finally, the party needs to reconnect with the people it claims to represent. Not by focus-grouping toughness. Not by pretending a photo op is a worldview. Not by hiding behind Trump every time someone asks what Democrats actually believe.
People want a party that listens, learns, fights, and tells the truth.
This autopsy mess showed the opposite.
That is why this matters.
Not because of the report itself.
Because of what the report revealed about the people leading the party.

A party without that foundation flails. It panders. It gaslights. It hides. It leaks. It spins. It releases a report and then distances itself from the report it released. That is not strength. That is weakness. The third issue is the disconnect from the people. Voters care about issues. They care about whether the party understands their lives. They care about cost of living, corruption, housing, jobs, health care, war, democracy, corporate power, and whether anyone in leadership is actually listening. But right now, too much of the Democratic Party is stuck in a branding war. You see Democrats reaching for tough-guy personas to show white male voters that they are just like them. Tim Walz pulls an air filter out of his car to show he understands engines. Graham Platner is the oyster farmer. Others try to present themselves as rugged, working-class, no-nonsense guys. But if the party thinks it can win with image instead of policy, people are going to see through that shit. People do not want cosplay. They want a party that knows what it believes and can actually fight for it. | | ---|---|--- The Autopsy Is a Symptom The Angry Democrat is reader-supported. Confidence in the Democratic Party is in the garbage. Approval ratings are in the toilet. People are frustrated, disillusioned, and tired that the only plan is "Trump bad, Republicans bad, GOP bad." Again, all of those criticisms may be true. But that is not a governing vision. That is not an ideological foundation. The problem is not the autopsy report. The problem is all the decisions that led to this moment. The nepotism. The gaslighting. The sloppy work. The bad judgment. The media tour explaining why the report would not be released. The reversal. The disclaimers. The backtracking. The fact that the party somehow managed to make itself look worse at every stage. This is not about the contents of the report. This is about leadership. It is about a Democratic Party that too often tries to create loyalty through fear instead of trust. It is about a party that tries to force unity instead of earning it. It is about a party that talks about being a big tent while punishing internal disagreement, ignoring grassroots frustration, and failing to build around clear Democratic populist ideas. That is the hill I will die on. We can do better. We should do better. And people are absolutely sick of being told that asking for better means they are hurting the party. The Solution The Democratic Party needs leadership that can be honest without panicking. If the party commissions a report and the report is bad, say it is bad. If the process was flawed, admit the process was flawed. If someone made a bad hiring decision, own it. If the party needs to start over, start over. That is leadership. The party also needs moral clarity. Democrats need to stop trying to brand their way out of an identity crisis and start building around actual policy, actual accountability, and actual economic and democratic reform. The party needs to stand for something people can understand without needing a consultant to explain it. And finally, the party needs to reconnect with the people it claims to represent. Not by focus-grouping toughness. Not by pretending a photo op is a worldview. Not by hiding behind Trump every time someone asks what Democrats actually believe. People want a party that listens, learns, fights, and tells the truth. This autopsy mess showed the opposite. That is why this matters. Not because of the report itself. Because of what the report revealed about the people leading the party. Stay Angry Join otherANGRY DEMOCRATS** by support Matt's work. If we flip this seat, we can end Lindsey Graham’s career and help Democrats retake the Senate, and expand the map for Democrats in future elections. I know this won’t be easy. But I’ve treated kids who were shot, hospitalized, and failed by broken systems. Nothing about this moment feels optional. We need an overwhelming surge of grassroots support to prove that we can finally defeat Lindsey Graham. So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in a split donation of $50, $30, or even $15 between Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign right now so we can hit our end of quarter goals? >> [] [] HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [] Let me introduce myself. I’ve spent nearly 20 years serving my community as a pediatrician, treating everything from asthma and violent trauma to the emotional toll of growing up in poverty. I’ve seen what bad policy does to good families — and I’ve seen kids suffer because people like Lindsey Graham would rather protect their own power than protect children. In 2022, after 15 years of working in hospitals, I ran for Congress because I knew our kids needed a voice in Washington. I lost — and I told my oldest daughter I wouldn’t run again. But then Trump’s chaos came back. And Lindsey Graham? He cheered. The truth is, I’m scared. And I’m angry. And I’m done waiting. So I’m stepping up — because our kids, and this country can’t afford another six years of Lindsey Graham. It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

clean_body: As America turns 250, we must honor them while we can | | | Patriot, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Patriot, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Patriot, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. | | **Peter, this month, our campaign hosted its first ever _Salsa En Vivo_ Brunch**, and more than 300 people came out — many attending a political event for the very first time.

I also debuted **La Orquesta Yeya** , the Salsa band I started with my high school friends, named after my late grandmother.

Music has always been a huge part of my life. My father is a musician, and I was proud to be the jazz band drummer at Osceola County School for the Arts. Getting to share music, culture, and the arts with our community brought me so much joy.
[](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/c4s2z8JAz_QcP8RxN2diuA~~/AAPPABA~/y-ykccVdGNP-8f1eS_LGLgYhatAWjS_hIUacytiMYcj0RlKKAURsamDo0BD8HD2oZ0ZWg3Gef_alZJD6C5f2ZIY1dHWVVKCt1BEmWe3WYqi1UhS7CTbLGJClend417BSzNk774etNc_bWj88xWntBqelm-W44JKHW8YFv0NJvwn6OriqAOn4pzmzjAf8STEthwePUyjQedcdavBfoeYXPYpLx0gv87p2VonN2UlSDFkCD3xIdRAHvHVvyuhqVQnxPV_c_0mCAEc7OvT-GweWaTZpirBDm5N54tv0nTav6WCUwYsKECf5hhQmUM6HCvFFT3GLSVwp0PJetuEEHvH90GRkwR6tL0WZUuhanYqZ-Ck~) This campaign isn't just about winning elections. It's about showing people a different way to do politics. One built on love, abundance, and showing up for each other.

And at a time when extremists in Florida are using hate to divide us, **we're choosing to lead with love.**

Peter, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life. But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy. I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense, or to have the President of the United States calling for my execution. Look, I don’t want you to worry about me. I’ve been through a lot in my life, and things like this don’t intimidate me all that much. I do worry that Trump might succeed at intimidating others, though. Like people just beginning to get involved, or thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a town hall. I worry Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him. But then I see millions of people meeting this moment with the courage and resolve it demands of them. Thomas Massie is gone. Bill Cassidy is gone. John Cornyn just made the list.
[Trump's revenge tour took out two Republicans in 72 hours ](https://us.list-manage.com/zzDEV7I4xzL?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)— and back home, Deb Haaland sat down with KRQE and gave the worst answer of her campaign.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/KAT4IclWxZV?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
💥 **TRUMP'S REVENGE TOUR JUST TOOK OUT TWO REPUBLICANS — CORNYN IS NEXT**
Ed Gallrein beat Massie in the most expensive House primary in American history. $32 million. A nine-point margin.
Massie's concession speech contained a line so ugly even Scott Jennings called it "despicable." We play it.
Three days earlier, Bill Cassidy — who voted to convict Trump in 2021 — finished third in Louisiana. Then Tuesday, Trump endorsed Ken Paxton over John Cornyn in Texas.
Mark explains the one rule every Republican senator now has to follow.
🔥 **HAALAND'S KRQE INTERVIEW FALLS APART ON FRACKING**
She said she'd ban fracking on public lands. Then she said New Mexico drills mostly on private land, so it'll be fine.
It won't be fine.
Mark walks through the actual number — and what cutting that much production would do to the state budget. When you hear what Haaland thinks New Mexico's economy is built on, you understand why she's going to refuse to debate.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/AOSr2lOoPh3?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🚨 **TRUMP'S LAWYERS SEND DUKE RODRIGUEZ A CEASE-AND-DESIST**
The Dhillon Law Group — Trump's attorneys — ordered Rodriguez to stop running an ad that features Trump in an Uncle Sam hat saying "I want you to vote Duke Rodriguez for governor."
Trump hasn't endorsed anyone in this race. Duke is calling it "political parody."
We break down why this is the kind of rookie mistake that ends campaigns.

🛸 **FOUR ALIEN SPECIES? AN 89-YEAR-OLD PHYSICIST SAYS YES.**
Dr. Hal Puthoff went on Steven Bartlett's podcast and told the world the US has recovered four different alien species from crashed UFOs.
Mark pulled the trailer for V from 1983. You're going to want to see this.

KATU: Vance calls on Congressional Republicans to pass SAVE Act during speech [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052226_1&amount=25]
Opponents of voting rights are trying everything they can think of to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address Trump's often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. Vice President J.D. Vance called on Congress again this week, begging them to pass this awful bill ahead of the next election.
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now, Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052226_1&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

Hey folks, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the full weight of the executive branch bearing down on me right now.
After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.

Dear Friend, This week provided another powerful reminder of why State Freedom Caucuses matter.When establishment politicians stay silent, State Freedom Caucuses force issues into the spotlight.When leadership wants controversy to disappear quietly, State Freedom Caucuses rally the grassroots and demand accountability. And when government institutions fail, State Freedom Caucuses refuse to pretend everything is fine.Here’s what happened this week.
---
|
---
**MARYLAND and ILLINOIS** Earlier this month, Maryland election officials sent over 400,000 mail-in ballots to voters ahead of the state’s primaries. There was just one problem.Many Republican voters reportedly received Democrat ballots instead. On May 16, the **Maryland Freedom Caucus** alerted the public to the fiasco and immediately began demanding answers. The MDFC worked with **Secure the Vote MD** to push the issue publicly and call for transparency, accountability, and a full investigation into how such a massive failure could occur. Fox News quickly picked up [the story.](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjpB6s8SVyitonD50ZO-2FFP7vn2A7ybcXGCBTAqQQjruiCUk6oYjZopuxTz7DJ7FwmBPzGopSDYhItLLiuyR5hawA9Dx9XHN0KebOwMs7xBN8QRan6t-2BfXLTfDH5Kk9lp4VtKy8nMIjiQyVRPU37jFBPo-3D9R3m_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHer3tTyngLx-2B-2Bp9N8fQaUdOMvvuN-2BX3fZUCRvSxYWUf942otT3zDlIv7PGIsP5teJsh3EKMswa5dASwSbq2SpsX9TC2eaLF4ecaIjrk763MRQf-2Bi4Tv5VuQlj-2FM8XIQyY8tWbnhGclVv11U134x8TFpg-2BEw1Wn4XrktlRpmXc6HlDYnqaJrasEPBtwaANZ0jMsEbgND8TOR85dkZC9Tunxs2DeRvbEu5RgT0WrV1K3t27I-3D)Meanwhile, what did Maryland House Republican leadership do?Not much. House Minority Leader Jason Buckel and leadership largely responded with a weak, obligatory social media post while the **Maryland Freedom Caucus** carried the fight publicly.Then the story exploded nationally. On May 18, President Trump posted on Truth Social calling on his Department of Justice to investigate Maryland’s mishandling of the ballots. The Republican National Committee echoed the call the same day.That escalation did not happen by accident. Without the **Maryland Freedom Caucus** aggressively pushing the issue, coordinating with election integrity activists, and refusing to let the story disappear, this likely would have remained a local embarrassment buried by the political establishment.Instead, it became a national election integrity issue.**PS: ILLINOIS RAISES SIMILAR CONCERNS** The Maryland situation is not happening in a vacuum.This week, the **Illinois Freedom Caucus** called for a federal investigation after reports that the Illinois Department of Human Services sent voter registration materials to noncitizens through an immigrant benefits program under Governor JB Pritzker’s administration. According to testimony cited by the Caucus, the materials included voter registration packets pre-addressed to local election authorities.The **Illinois Freedom Caucus** warned that Illinois law now prevents local election officials from independently verifying citizenship status on voter registration applications received by mail. The Caucus is now calling on President Trump’s Department of Justice to investigate whether state officials facilitated improper noncitizen voter registration activity.The **Illinois Freedom Caucus** also renewed its support for the SAVE Act requiring proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections. Watch State Rep. Adam Niemerg’s floor speech exposing the issue [here.](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjjNgy2B639IYX5NmiaQZGn7EBIi-2Fj1XFOMlQnFIreDg0xoI8qZ6T2B-2FcwwatmWqUGOyodOEqIkfHk4OEiGfFmL4-3DMamD_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHer3tTyngLx-2B-2Bp9N8fQaUdOMvvuN-2BX3fZUCRvSxYWUf942otT3zDlIv7PGIsP5teJsh3EKMswa5dASwSbq2SpsX9TC2eaLF4ecaIjrk763MRQc74SZwvIrSez-2Fhm-2FxMQ-2FjwkxHlleZfvtdZBGcMmBx1raNN3qeSw1vK1Bfiq8Ul04eALz-2FdGmpY2s7rR7YT9EytyoVhBnqRT7V1Sm34M0Ov95PwuS-2FgzWQYBYuFY6VqlNY-3D)

**SOUTH CAROLINA** Last year, Governor Henry McMaster appointed Edward Simmer as South Carolina’s interim Director of Public Health.Most Republicans said nothing.But the **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** did. The SCFC immediately began warning the public about Simmer’s record during COVID, including his support for masking guidance, vaccine policies, and broader pandemic-era government overreach.At first, the Freedom Caucus stood almost entirely alone.**⚡️** They held rallies.
**⚡️** They went on conservative radio.
**⚡️** They educated grassroots activists.
**⚡️** They forced the issue into public debate.SC Freedom Caucus member Sarita Edgerton even introduced a budget amendment cutting Simmer’s salary to $1.The Swamp killed the amendment 73-30.But the **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** did not back down. They kept the pressure on until confirming Simmer became politically toxic.And eventually, the legislative session ended without Senate confirmation.By law, Simmer lost the job.That alone would have been a major victory.But then Governor McMaster appointed Brannon Traxler as his replacement.The Freedom Caucus quickly dug into her record and exposed:**⚡️** She donated to Joe Biden and other Democrat candidates**⚡️** She supported COVID mask mandates and shutdowns**⚡️** She called on President Trump to be impeached These are not the traits of a neutral public health official. Traxler is a leftwing ideologue...appointed by a "Republican" governor!SC Freedom Caucus member Alan Morgan introduced a resolution demanding her removal. Thirty-two House Republicans co-sponsored it. The South Carolina Freedom Caucus then mobilized conservative media, grassroots activists, and groups like Moms for Liberty to increase pressure on the Governor.Since the legislative session had already ended, Traxler could temporarily remain in office absent removal by the Governor.So the SC Freedom Caucus escalated again. They publicly challenged every gubernatorial candidate in South Carolina to take a position on Traxler.Every single one opposed her.Even the Governor’s own lieutenant governor!At this point, Traxler’s future is effectively over before it even begins.This is how Freedom Caucuses win. Not merely by casting votes, but by changing the political environment so dramatically that bad policies and bad appointments become politically impossible to sustain.

Fox News quickly picked up , what did Maryland House Republican leadership do?Not much. House Minority Leader Jason Buckel and leadership largely responded with a weak, obligatory social media post while the Maryland Freedom Caucus carried the fight publicly.Then the story exploded nationally. The Republican National Committee echoed the call the same day.That escalation did not happen by accident. name: Small Town PAC
subject: We hear you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
Our team wants to stay connected every step of the way.
#
Peter,
Last month, when Tim Walz launched Small Town PAC, we asked supporters across the country to tell us which issues mattered most to them and their communities.
_The response was incredible._ We heard from people everywhere about the challenges they’re facing, the issues they cared most about, and what they feel politicians too often get wrong about places like theirs.
**The top three issues folks said they’re most concerned about right now are:**
🗳️ Voting rights and our democracy
🏥 Healthcare
🌎 Climate change and the environment
Some other concerns people brought up included creating more affordable housing, protecting our national parks and monuments, defending family farms and the U.S. Postal Service, and stopping ICE from terrorizing our communities.
**We hear you.** Now, we’re reaching out again because building the support we need to deliver real results for our communities starts with listening — but it continues by staying connected to the people we’re fighting for and making sure their voices guide our work every step of the way.
[**Your feedback helps shape the issues we focus on and how we continue rebuilding Democratic leadership from the ground up. So please, take our May Issues Survey today >>**](https://act.timwalz.com/survey/may-issues-survey/?source=em20260522-671&t=1&akid=671%2E34582%2ED4sFBX)
**[Take the Survey ››](https://act.timwalz.com/survey/may-issues-survey/?source=em20260522-671&t=2&akid=671%2E34582%2ED4sFBX)**
Thanks for sharing your input with Tim and the rest of our team.
With gratitude,
Small Town PAC

Tim Walz started Small Town PAC to build a Democratic Party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.
**[It’s time for Democrats to expand the map and put small towns back at the forefront: pitch in now to help build our movement from the ground up.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260522-671&t=3&refcode2=671_34582_D4sFBX&akid=671%2E34582%2ED4sFBX)**

name: API PA
subject: We did it! Chris Rabb wins the Democratic nomination in PA-03
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
After months of organizing, Chris Rabb has won the Democratic nomination in Pennsylvania’s third congressional district representing a large part of Philadelphia!
This victory belongs to the people. Our communities came together because we knew what was at stake. This district is home to many working class communities of color, including Asian immigrant and refugee communities. We are facing real challenges like rising costs, cuts to public services, and increasing attacks on immigrant and refugee communities from ICE and the Trump administration.
From the very beginning, our members saw in Chris someone who would truly fight for our communities. He has stood up for immigrant rights, fought for affordability, and refused to take money from corporate PACs. He showed us that his values can’t be bought and voters across Philadelphia responded to that leadership.
But this win didn’t happen on its own.
https://www.instagram.com/p/DYi2lxtgYK1/ [https://www.instagram.com/p/DYi2lxtgYK1/]
Together, our communities built a powerful multilingual voter outreach program. Over the past several weeks, volunteers made calls, knocked doors, talked with neighbors, and helped voters understand what was at stake in this election. We ran digital ads in Indonesian and Vietnamese and sent mailers in English, Chinese, Vietnamese, Bangla, and Khmer to make sure our communities had the information they needed to vote.
And we didn’t do this alone. This victory was possible because we organized as part of a powerful multiracial coalition. We worked with our partner organizations like One Pennsylvania and the Working Families Party to fight for a future rooted where all of our communities are taken care of.
And people showed up after hearing our message. Philly voters recognized in Chris Rabb the same thing we saw when we endorsed him: a bold leader with courage, integrity, and a deep commitment to justice.
This victory showed what’s possible when our communities come together and organize for the future we deserve. If you believe in building power for Asian American communities, fighting for working people, and creating a Pennsylvania where all of us can thrive, we hope you’ll become a member of API PA. Join us in this movement and help shape what comes next alongside neighbors who are ready to fight for justice, solidarity, and real change. [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/membership?am=15.00&contactdata=KwGFmEAcz9/MR6+kr+CJE12BTngB6jSsngTE7TlHIKwq8+ZWbSvUwjx3EAxfoJKlbEgKYwB3lQrMeP3NfS86l4hLgLHaFR6DasMrPsvGLulD33x7SLwYWO+IYStq49I1cOOo5B5+DhpXg6sxzYlFYN6nSPH1QzrAQV0VRrP8ebE=]
In solidarity,
Mohan Seshadri
Executive Director

Derek,
I’m the hope and change guy, but I’ll be honest: we’ve got some real work to do in this country. And if we want to make progress, we’ll need leaders who tell the truth, tackle hard problems, and serve the people who put them in office in the first place.
The good news is we have the chance to elect leaders like that _this year_ — in both houses of Congress, governorships, state legislatures, and offices up and down the ballot.
But it’s going to take all of us to do it.
**It’s up to all of us, as citizens, to stand up for our values. We can’t just leave it to somebody else. We have to fight, even when it’s hard.**
Republicans want you to think that a few people in power make all the decisions and the rest of us have to live with the consequences. But when you look at the history of America, real change has always come from the bottom up — from ordinary folks who make it happen.
So yes, we are being tested. But we have the power, as citizens, to change this country.
We’ve just got to use it.
Derek, the DNC is the only organization working to elect the Democratic leaders we need at all levels of government, all across the country. When you chip in to the DNC, you’re supporting thousands of candidates we must elect this year.

| | Friend,
I’m going to be completely honest with you.
After sitting down with Senate leadership and hearing what’s coming, I realized how dangerously close we are to losing **_everything_** President Trump is fighting for.
**_The Senate majority is hanging by a thread._**
One seat. One race. One loss.
If the Left takes control, they will shut Trump down immediately, blocking his agenda, burying his priorities, and ensuring nothing meaningful gets done. They’re already preparing for it.
And that _**_terrifies_**_ me.
Not because of my position, but because I may not be able to help President Trump when it matters most.
That’s why I wrote a confidential note meant only for a small number of conservatives who still understand what’s at stake. This was not written for the public, and it won’t stay available for long.
**You were one of the people I felt I had to share it with, Friend.**
Please don’t put this off. Read what I wrote, understand the danger we’re facing, and decide whether you’re willing to stand with us before it’s too late.
**[Read my private note here (do not share):](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)**
---

|
---
If liberals control the Senate, Trump’s presidency will be crippled.
I refuse to let that happen without exhausting every possible option.
Thank you for hearing me out,
Katie Britt

_**Faith. Family. Freedom.**_

The Left is doing everything they can to tear it all down. But I didn’t come to Washington to play games. I came to fight for the people who feel forgotten, overlooked, and ignored.

From securing the border to protecting our kids and defending our way of life—I’m in this for the long haul.

**This fight isn’t easy, but it’s worth it. And I’m not going anywhere.**

Will you stand with me?

Just like me, Marty's path into politics was far from conventional. Most people know him as the guy behind the Halo soundtrack (Yes, the popular video game) and the jingles for We Are Flintstone Kids and Mr. Clean. After a successful music career, he's taken the leap of faith to run for Congress in NV-03, against a career politician who's as radical as they come, Susie Lee.
She voted AGAINST No Tax On Tips, AGAINST wall funding, and AGAINST banning men in women's sports. Marty O'Donnell will make sure every voter hears about her far-Left record.
That's why President Trump and I support him 100%. He just earned our full endorsement and even joined the President at his big event in Las Vegas.
Unfortunately, this won't be an easy race to win. President Trump and I won this district in 2024, but Susie Lee has a FORTUNE at her disposal to attack MAGA and lie about her record.

## Saving taxpayer money under Trump 2.0
On May 5, 1984, President Ronald Reagan delivered a radio address to the nation.
The focus of his address?
Waste, fraud, abuse, and mismanagement in the federal government.
While a lot's changed since President Reagan left office in 1989, a lot has remained the same.
The news media loves headlines about foreign policy.
Yet, what doesn't make the news is what's happening in our own backyard.
For too long, as President Reagan once noted, the United States government has been mired in waste, fraud, abuse, and mismanagement.
That brings me to one of the most unique wins of Trump 2.0: DOGE.
Almost every president in recent memory has promised to restore government efficiency.
Trump delivered.
Following in the pattern of Reagan, his second administration has been able to deliver on promises where other presidents failed.
Let's break down why...

clean_body: The next runoffs are just weeks away | | | First of all, thank you to everyone who pitched in and helped get out the vote in the Peach State’s major elections this week. Georgians were clearly determined to make their voices heard — breaking early-vote records with over a million ballots cast before Tuesday. Democrats’ early turnout surged by 56% compared to the same point four years ago. People are fired up and ready to take ownership of our democracy. = We’re excited to congratulate the 15 Democracy Champions we endorsed who won their primaries. From the State Senate and the State House to the County Commission and City Council levels, these pro-voter leaders will keep fighting for equal access to the ballot box. We also recognize two Georgia Supreme Court candidates, Miracle Rankin and Jen Jordan, who came up short but still galvanized voters, inspired waves of volunteers, and shined a light on elections that usually don’t get enough attention. They were in uphill battles against sitting Justices — it’s been over a century since the last time an incumbent lost their seat on the Georgia Supreme Court. But without a doubt, Miracle and Jen have laid the groundwork for future victories, and we will keep fighting to elect Justices who uphold the will of the people in our democracy. Georgia’s next elections are just weeks away, with primary runoffs set for June 16. We’re proud to endorse another slate of Democracy Champions for these critical positions that shape how elections are run: Josh McLaurin Georgia Lieutenant Governor Dana Barrett Georgia Secretary of State Mo Ivory Fulton County Commission Chair Jodi Merriday Fulton County Commission District 3 DeAndre Mathis Georgia Insurance Commission And November will be here before we know it — we’re honored to endorse these Democracy Champions for the statewide general election: Keisha Lance Bottoms Georgia Governor Tanya Miller Georgia Attorney General Peter Hubbard Georgia Public Service Commissioner, District 3 With free and fair elections under constant attack from the Trump Regime and their bootlickers here in Georgia, state and local officials are the last line of defense for democracy. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- In solidarity, The Fair Fight Team * = = | 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2026 Fair Fight - All rights reserved. I'm humbled by all of this.
Never in my life did I expect to be running for office. When I was a teenager, our family's house burned down. Nothing survived besides a ring and a medallion of Jesus.
_The Lehigh Valley took me in, and this community became my world._ Since then, I've worn a lot of hats, from fighting fires, to clearing snow, landscaping, and leading a union. The constant: I've spent my career protecting people and serving them.
Unlike Donald Trump, I wasn't born with a silver spoon in my mouth.
Most of these politicians in Washington have never had a hard month or a hard year. I have. I've faced foreclosure. I've watched our healthcare system put corporate profits ahead of what's best for people. I've lived paycheck to paycheck from day one in the work force.
**I'm running for Congress because our people deserve a representative who knows the challenges they face and will go the extra mile to make their lives a little easier.**
